reason: I already keep a spreadsheet and it works. Typing a transaction takes me a minute and I know my numbers. I would try the free part to see, but I do not see why I would pay 69 baht a month to save that minute.
objection: The spreadsheet already does the job, and I do not trust an app to read my bank slips and statements correctly without me checking every line anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If I tried the statement import for a month and it filled in the categories correctly with almost no fixes, saving me real time every month.
